```{r load data}
rfk_tracts <- read.csv("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/rfk_tracts.csv")

censustrend <- read.csv("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Result/census_trends_2000_2020.csv") 
  names(censustrend)[names(censustrend) == "Geo2020"] <- "GEOID"
  censustrend$GEOID <- as.numeric(censustrend$GEOID)


tracts <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Census_Tracts_in_2020/Census_Tracts_in_2020.shp") %>%
  select(GEOID, geometry) %>%
  mutate(GEOID = as.numeric(GEOID))

rfk_tracts_shape <- rfk_tracts %>%
  left_join(tracts, by = "GEOID")

censustrend_shape <- tracts %>%
  left_join(censustrend, by = "GEOID")

censustrend_rfk <- rfk_tracts %>%
  left_join( censustrend, by = "GEOID") 
 
```
```{r map prep}
#for outlines of the RFK areas
west_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(west_of_anacostia == 1)

east_outline <- rfk_tracts_shape %>%
  filter(east_of_anacostia == 1)

outlines <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data = west_outline, aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  geom_sf(data = east_outline, aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group), fill = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#ec008b", "#fdbf11"), name = "RFK Area")
outlines

metro <- st_read("//sas1/dcdata/Libraries/Requests/Prog/2026/RFK/Data/Metro_Stations_Regional/Metro_Stations_Regional.shp") %>%
  mutate(line1 = case_when(LINE == "blue, yellow"~ "yellow",
                           LINE == "blue, orange, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "blue, silver"~ "blue",
                           LINE == "green, yellow, orange, blue, silver"~ "green",
                           LINE == "green, yellow"~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, green, yellow" ~ "green",
                           LINE == "red, blue, orange, silver"~ "red", 
                           LINE == "red, green" ~ "green", 
                           LINE == "orange, silver" ~ "orange"
                           ),
         line_name = if_else(is.na(line1), LINE, line1), 
         line_color = if_else(line_name == "silver", "grey", line_name))
dc_metro <- metro %>%
  st_filter(., dc, .predicate = st_intersects)

```{new maps}

format_interval <- function(interval_text) {

  text <- interval_text %>%
    str_remove_all("\\(") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\)") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\[") %>%
    str_remove_all("\\]") %>%
    str_replace_all(",", " — ")

  text <- text %>%
    str_split(" — ") %>%
    map(~ as.numeric(.x) %>%
          scales::comma() %>%
          paste0(collapse = " — ")) %>%
    unlist() %>%
    fct_rev()

  return(text)
}

format_interval <- function(interval_factor) {

  levs <- levels(interval_factor)

  new_levs <- levs %>%
    str_remove_all("\\(|\\)|\\[|\\]") %>%
    str_split(",") %>%
    map_chr(~ paste(scales::comma(as.numeric(.x)), collapse = " — "))

  levels(interval_factor) <- new_levs

  interval_factor
}

censustrend_shape2 <- censustrend_shape %>%
  mutate(chgpop_interval = cut(
    ChgTotPop_2000_2020, 
    breaks=c(-1800,-200, 200, 700, 1300, 3352), 
    labels = c(
        "-1,800 – -200",
        "-200 – 200",
        "200 – 700",
        "700 – 1,300",
        "1,300 – 3,351"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
    )%>%
  mutate(chgBLKpop_interval = cut(
    ChgBlackNHBridge_2000_2020,
    breaks=c(-1900,-500, 0, 500, 1000, 1652),
    labels = c(
        "-1,900 – -500",
        "-500 – 0",
        "0 – 500",
        "500 – 1,000",
        "1,000 – 1,651"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      ordered_result = TRUE
    )
  )
  

  pop_change <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = censustrend_shape2,
    aes(geometry = geometry,
    # Color in tracts by the change in pop 2000-2020
    fill = chgpop_interval
  )) +
  # Default is to use main urban palette, which assumes unrelated groups. We
  # adjust colors manually to be on Urban diverging palate
  # run view_palette() to see the colors
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = palette_urbn_diverging[c(2, 4, 5, 7, 8)],
    name = "Change in Population 2000-2020"
  )+
  geom_sf(
    data = west_outline,
    aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = east_outline,
    aes(geometry = geometry, color = rfk_sub_group),
    fill = NA
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("#ec008b", "#fdbf11"),
    name = "RFK Area"
  )+
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )
pop_change

ggsave(filename = "C:/Users/lhendey/Box/Greater DC/Projects/RFK Stadium Analysis/Results/CensusTrends/population change.png",
       plot = pop_change,
       device = "png",
       width = 6.5,
